text:
maya: Heads up — since flipping the strict_validate canary (fn/invoke) to 5% we saw a ~8x spike in fncall schema rejections last 10m. payloads look okay but validator is rejecting on subtle extra fields. :eyes:

alex: Can you paste an example rejection log? which validator version and ruleset?

maya: pasted a minimal example from the logs: ```{"request_id":"r_12ab","tool":"payment_api.charge","args":{"amount":1200,"currency":"usd","meta":{"sdk_version":"1.4.3-beta"}}}``` rejection reason: "unexpected field meta" from validator v2.3.1

sarah: hmm that meta nesting is something we've allowed historically (SDK added it). strict_validate is treating it as unknown. Were we expecting a coercion policy to strip unknowns?

jun: Related: the canary rollout doesn't set the softfail flag — strict_validate true == hard reject. Maybe the canary should run in warn-only mode first so we collect telemetry without impacting responses.

maya: Agreed. Impact note: about 210 requests rejected in the 5% segment, ~12% of those are causing downstream retry loops and counting as failed invocations in SLO graphs. Billing/usage unaffected but errors spike.

deploy-bot: Canary update: strict_validate toggle for route fn/invoke at 5% applied by maya at 2024-11-18T15:02:01Z.

alex: For telemetry we should tag these with fncall.validator_version and rejection_type. Proposed quick query for the dashboard (pseudo-KQL): ```logs | where route=="fn/invoke" and outcome=="reject" and tag=="strict_validate" | summarize count() by validator_version, rejection_reason``` put this on the fncall-health panel.

sarah: Also add a sampling of the raw payloads to the sample-bucket (redaction on PII). We need examples for SDK owners.

jun: Ops suggestion: change canary behavior to "warn-only" (emit rejection metric + sample payload, but allow response through) for next 24h. That prevents retry storms and lets SDK teams fix shapes.

maya: Will do the rollback -> warn-only plan. Patch: update rollout config to {"strict_validate":true, "mode":"warn"} for canary. Who wants to own reaching out to SDK?

alex: I can send a brief note to sdk-team with example payloads + how to opt-in to new schema. I'll link the dashboard once we have the metrics.

ops-monitor: Alert created: fncall.strict_reject_rate > 0.5% sustained for 5m on fn/invoke (alert id: ALRT-2024-11-18-09). Dashboard: https://rdw.console/dashboards/fncall-health

maya: Thanks. Action items: (1) maya -> flip canary mode to warn-only (in 10m) (2) alex -> notify sdk-team + paste samples (3) sarah -> add sampling pipeline + redact PII (4) jun -> add telemetry tags and dashboard panels. I'll post confirmation when canary updated. :thumbsup:

alex: ack, will draft the SDK note now.

maya: done — canary set to warn-only at 1717654375. Rejection metric still emitted but responses pass through. Monitoring closely.

sarah: verifying samples landed in sample-bucket, looks good. redact rules applied.

jun: added tags fncall.validator=v2.3.1 and fncall.mode=warn to metrics. Dashboard updated. Pulling 50 sample payloads for SDK.

maya: closing the loop — no more retry storms, error graphs stable. Follow-up: plan a permissive->strict rollout path in docs and add a console toggle that defaults to warn for new strict validators.

alex: +1, will add a note to rollout playbook and create a quick Console UX ticket for the toggle.
